page_title: ARS 5-0 CRY | Arsenal v Crystal Palace 20/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' 5 - 0 Goal - 5:0! Jorginho tees up Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Dean Henderson.
90+4' 4 - 0 Goal - 4:0! Eddie Nketiah laid the ball off to Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
90+1' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) watches the corner all the way, but places his header just over the bar from close range.
90+1' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' The substitution has been made. James Tomkins (Crystal Palace) has replaced Marc Guehi.
81' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a change. Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) replaces Gabriel.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gabriel Jesus departs the field of play to be replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal).
79' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner which is cleared.
79' A pass into the penalty area from Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Crystal Palace.
76' Here is a change. Nathaniel Clyne is going off and Roy Hodgson gives the last tactical orders to Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace).
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jeffrey Schlupp will be replaced by Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace).
75' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
73' Jorginho (Arsenal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Declan Rice.
69' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) replacing Kai Havertz.
69' Mikel Arteta has decided to substitute Leandro Trossard and he is replaced by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal).
68' Substitution. Will Hughes walks off the pitch and David Ozoh (Crystal Palace) comes on as a substitute.
66' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
65' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
65' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
64' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner.

64' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for David Raya to dive and make a save. Crystal Palace force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
61' Paul Tierney sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
60' The Arsenal players halt their celebrations as referee Paul Tierney makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

59' 3 - 0 GOAL! Gabriel Jesus finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Leandro Trossard (Arsenal), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 3:0.
59' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Raya, who smothers the ball.
59' Crystal Palace can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
58' PENALTY APPEAL after Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
58' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
57' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball is out of play. Arsenal win a corner kick.
55' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal), who has already been caught several times today.
52' Paul Tierney blows the whistle, Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul.
50' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) swings in a cross from the corner, but David Raya reads it well and gathers the ball.

49' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but David Raya has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Crystal Palace are going to take it.
46' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

46' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Arsenal will have a corner.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+2' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45+1' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but David Raya is equal to it and makes an easy save.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
43' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
42' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at David Raya.
37' 2 - 0 Gabriel (Arsenal) reacts quickly in the penalty area and scores with aplomb, giving the goalkeeper no chance!
37' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
36' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends a low pass from outside the box to Bukayo Saka. He lines up a shot, but the defence intercepts at the last moment. Arsenal have a corner.
34' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

34' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but David Raya easily deals with the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Crystal Palace.
31' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace).
27' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
26' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) heads on.
24' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and it's Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
22' A fine corner kick lands on the head of Gabriel (Arsenal), but he is unable to direct it accurately and it flies well wide of the right post from close in.
22' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will take the corner.
21' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Arsenal will take a corner kick.
21' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
20' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
16' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
14' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
13' Ben White (Arsenal) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
11' 1 - 0 Gooal! Declan Rice takes over corner duties. Gabriel (Arsenal) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
11' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is about to take a corner kick.
10' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out for a corner. Arsenal can continue in their attacking effort.
7' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
5' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
3' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Paul Tierney.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
